name: MFF Clash of the Champions '99

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline, "September 30," combined with its own title "Clash of the Champions '99."

appearances.note: Ran in with a steel chair to help Blizzard win the Light Weight title.
Ran in and chair-shot Spawn from behind, then rolled him in for Destroyer's near-fall.
Speared and Tiger Bombed the interfering Destroyer, saving Spawn's title defense.
Special referee for the World Title match; attacked with a chair and Tomb Stoned after the bell amid a staged explosion and a dummy prop of himself.

notes: Five matches served, crowning the International, Light Weight, and World Titles and marking Midevil Spawn's own retained Heavy Weight Championship defense; the debuting Unstoppables (Dare Devil & Stryfe) also defeated the Red Bloods (Dead Pool & Kane) in a non-title tag match.

matches.note: MFF International Title. Weapon-X entered as a mystery special opponent to AC/DC's "Highway to Hell" and won by pinfall.
MFF Light Weight Title. Cannonball ran in with a steel chair to help Blizzard, per a signal Night Crawler caught but couldn't stop.

MFF Heavy Weight Title, Spawn defending. Robo Destroyer chair-shotted Spawn and rolled him in for a Destroyer near-fall; Terrax speared and Tiger Bombed Destroyer, and Spawn finished with a Choke Slam and two Tombstones to retain.
Non-title. The debuting Unstoppables' first win, over Dead Pool & Kane's own Red Bloods — Dare Devil chair-shotted an injured Dead Pool for the deciding pin.

MFF World Title, Deathlok defending. GW Bridge worked the match as special referee and counted the deciding fall; after the bell, Spawn attacked him with a chair and a Tomb Stone amid a staged explosion and a dummy prop of himself.
